title: 第13章 义顺堂大堂主徐飞暗劲巅峰第15章 化劲宗师的可怕傅进谦倭国领事山本一郎
slug: 我武举人晚年才来武学修改器
content_zh:
通宵熬夜，还胡吃海塞大量的补品，若是放在陆云还没有突破化劲之前，以他那副六十岁，一身气血衰败的老迈身躯，怕不是早就猝死过去了。
但此刻陆云只觉得整个人神清气爽，体内气血旺盛，精力充沛，甚至比许多壮年人还要旺盛几分。
“人逢喜事精神爽啊。”
陆云笑了笑，他缓缓起身，舒展了一下筋骨，全身关节发出充满活力的“噼啪”
声。
“是时候去用早膳了。”
陆家的餐厅设在西洋风格别墅的一楼，对此，陆云从来没有反对过。
他可不是那些固步自封、视西洋事物为洪水猛兽的老顽固。
在陆云眼中，实用与舒适才是第一位的，这些西洋的沙发、玻璃窗、乃至用餐的桌椅格局，确实有其便利和敞亮之处，拿来用用又何妨？
他拄着拐杖走出自己的院落，朝着别墅主楼方向行去。
餐厅内，长媳沈洛莹见到陆云进来后，连忙低声催促着几个孩子：“明理，还有你们几个，都愣着干什么？快叫爷爷！”
陆家的孙辈们此刻齐聚一堂。
作为长房，沈洛莹育有长孙陆明理和孙女陆小莹。
次子陆景军，比大哥陆景腾小一岁，今年二十八，娶了李知瑜为妻。
这门亲事连陆云当初都颇感意外，这个臭小子居然能在国都燕京市，结识并娶到军统一位肩扛一星将军的千金，也算是有几分本事和运道。
如今陆景军留在燕京市，在岳父麾下做事，幸好他年轻时跟着陆云打熬过筋骨，练到了暗劲层次，倒也不至于丢了陆家武人的脸面。
李知瑜为陆家添了一男三女，陆云对这些孙辈一视同仁，根本就不可能会有重男轻女的想法。
至于最小的儿子陆景耀，那就是个让陆云头疼的家伙。
今年二十五，二十岁那年非要说什么“睁眼看世界”
，直接跑去了远隔重洋的法兰西国留学。

陆云拗不过他，又不放心，就派了几个早年跟着自己习武、忠心可靠的徒弟一路护送。
这一去就是五年，到现在连个人影都难得见到，好在隔三差五还有书信回来报个平安，否则陆云真有可能亲自跑一趟法兰西去揪他回来。
最近一次回信里，陆云已经撂下话了：今年过年再不回来，老子就亲自去法兰西“看望”
你！
“哈哈哈，我的乖孙们！”
陆云看着那几个叽叽喳喳、极为活泼的孙子孙女，脸上露出了难得一见的慈和笑容。
他顺手将一直握着的紫檀木拐杖往旁边一靠，直接弯下腰张开双臂。
一手一个，将离得最近的两个小家伙轻松抱了起来！
餐桌上摆满了各式菜肴，中西合璧，琳琅满目。
一边是西洋新派菜式，煎得恰到好处的牛扒、红艳艳的罗宋汤、细腻的鹅肝、晶莹的鱼子酱、酸甜的番茄虾仁。
另一边则是传统的中式早餐：清粥小菜、豆浆油条、水晶虾饺、蟹黄汤包。
陆家财力雄厚，为了满足不同口味，特意聘请了好几位擅长西洋菜式和中式菜点的大厨。
年轻人嘛，总是更容易被新鲜事物吸引，几个年纪稍大的孙子孙女已经好奇的将叉子伸向了牛扒和鹅肝。
content_en:
He stayed up all night and ate a lot of supplements from Hai Sai. If Lu Yun had not broken through the power, he would have died suddenly long ago with his sixty-year-old body with declining energy and blood.
But at this moment, Lu Yun only felt that his whole body was refreshed, his body's qi and blood were strong, and he was full of energy, even a little more energetic than many middle-aged people.
"People feel refreshed when happy events occur."
Lu Yun smiled. He slowly stood up and stretched his muscles. The joints in his body made an energetic "crackling" sound.
sound.
"It's time for breakfast."
The Lu family's restaurant is located on the first floor of a Western-style villa. Lu Yun has never objected to this.
He is not one of those stubborn old fogies who regard Western things as scourges.
In Lu Yun's eyes, practicality and comfort are the first priority. These Western sofas, glass windows, and even dining tables and chairs do have their convenience and openness, so why not use them?
He walked out of his courtyard on crutches and headed towards the main building of the villa.
In the restaurant, when the eldest daughter-in-law Shen Luoying saw Lu Yun come in, she quickly urged the children in a low voice: "Mingli, and you guys, what are you doing standing still? Call me grandpa!"
The grandchildren of the Lu family are gathered together at this moment.
As the eldest son, Shen Luoying has her eldest grandson Lu Mingli and granddaughter Lu Xiaoying.
The second son, Lu Jingjun, is one year younger than his eldest brother Lu Jingteng. He is 28 this year and married to Li Zhiyu.
Even Lu Yun was surprised by this marriage at first. This brat could actually meet and marry the daughter of a military commander who carried a one-star general in the capital city of Yanjing. It was considered to be quite capable and lucky.
Now Lu Jingjun is staying in Yanjing City, working under his father-in-law. Fortunately, he fought hard with Lu Yun when he was young and has reached the level of Anjin, so he will not lose the face of the Lu family martial arts.
Li Zhiyu added one boy and three girls to the Lu family. Lu Yun treated these grandchildren equally and there was no way he would think of favoring boys over girls.
As for the youngest son Lu Jingyao, he is a headache for Lu Yun.
I am twenty-five this year. When I was twenty, I had to say "open your eyes and see the world."
, went directly to study in France, which is far away across the ocean.
Lu Yun couldn't defeat him and was worried, so he sent a few loyal and reliable apprentices who had practiced martial arts with him in his early years to escort him all the way.
He has been away for five years, and it is rare to even see him in person now. Fortunately, there are letters coming back every now and then to say that he is safe, otherwise Lu Yun might really go to France to catch him back.
In his latest reply, Lu Yun had already given up his words: If he doesn’t come back for the Chinese New Year this year, I will personally go to France to “visit” him.
You!
"Hahaha, my good grandchildren!"
Lu Yun looked at the chirping and lively grandchildren, with a rare kind smile on his face.
He smoothly leaned the rosewood crutch he had been holding aside, bent down and opened his arms.
With one hand in each hand, he easily picked up the two nearest little ones!
The dining table is filled with all kinds of dishes, a dazzling array of Chinese and Western dishes.
On one side are Western new-style dishes, perfectly fried steak, red borscht, delicate foie gras, crystal caviar, and sweet and sour tomato shrimp.
On the other side is a traditional Chinese breakfast: porridge and side dishes, soy milk and fried dough sticks, crystal shrimp dumplings, and crab roe soup dumplings.
The Lu family has strong financial resources. In order to satisfy different tastes, they have hired several chefs who are good at Western and Chinese dishes.
Young people are always more attracted to new things, and several older grandchildren have already curiously stretched their forks towards steak and foie gras.
